```sql
SELECT customer_id
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
```

This query first filters the orders to only include those placed in the last 90 days. It then groups the remaining orders by customer_id. The HAVING clause is used to filter these groups, and only those with more than three orders are included in the final result.
